# pve-rclone-backup completion

Generate the autocompletion script for the specified shell.

Generate the autocompletion script for pve-rclone-backup for the specified shell.
See each sub-command's help for details on how to use the generated script.

| Command | Description |
|---|---|
| [`bash`](#completion-bash) | Generate the autocompletion script for bash |
| [`fish`](#completion-fish) | Generate the autocompletion script for fish |
| [`powershell`](#completion-powershell) | Generate the autocompletion script for powershell |
| [`zsh`](#completion-zsh) | Generate the autocompletion script for zsh |

## completion bash

Generate the autocompletion script for the bash shell.

This script depends on the 'bash-completion' package.
If it is not installed already, you can install it via your OS's package manager.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source &lt;(pve-rclone-backup completion bash)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	pve-rclone-backup completion bash &gt; /etc/bash_completion.d/pve-rclone-backup

#### macOS:

	pve-rclone-backup completion bash &gt; $(brew --prefix)/etc/bash_completion.d/pve-rclone-backup

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

```
pve-rclone-backup completion bash
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | disable completion descriptions |

## completion fish

Generate the autocompletion script for the fish shell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	pve-rclone-backup completion fish | source

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

	pve-rclone-backup completion fish &gt; ~/.config/fish/completions/pve-rclone-backup.fish

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

```
pve-rclone-backup completion fish [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | disable completion descriptions |

## completion powershell

Generate the autocompletion script for powershell.

To load completions in your current shell session:

	pve-rclone-backup completion powershell | Out-String | Invoke-Expression

To load completions for every new session, add the output of the above command
to your powershell profile.

```
pve-rclone-backup completion powershell [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | disable completion descriptions |

## completion zsh

Generate the autocompletion script for the zsh shell.

If shell completion is not already enabled in your environment you will need
to enable it.  You can execute the following once:

	echo "autoload -U compinit; compinit" &gt;&gt; ~/.zshrc

To load completions in your current shell session:

	source &lt;(pve-rclone-backup completion zsh)

To load completions for every new session, execute once:

#### Linux:

	pve-rclone-backup completion zsh &gt; "${fpath[1]}/_pve-rclone-backup"

#### macOS:

	pve-rclone-backup completion zsh &gt; $(brew --prefix)/share/zsh/site-functions/_pve-rclone-backup

You will need to start a new shell for this setup to take effect.

```
pve-rclone-backup completion zsh [flags]
```

**Options**

| Option | Description |
|---|---|
| `--no-descriptions` | disable completion descriptions |

Every command also accepts the [global options](index.md#global-options).
